ruleDefinitions.name: MSSQL XPCmdshell Option Change
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects when the MSSQL "xp_cmdshell" stored procedure setting is changed.
 Note: Unmapped fields: Provider_Name, Data

sequences.query: (Provider_Name = RGX(".*MSSQL.*") AND event_id = 15457 AND Data = RGX(".*xp\\_cmdshell.*"))
